description: Control over LuaJIT's debug hook functionality. This library is deprecated and mostly useless now.

functions.name: enable
functions.description: Re-enables debug hooks after they have been disabled. Hooks are enabled by default.
functions.deprecated: LJE automatically manages hooks now - does nothing.

functions.name: disable
functions.description: Disables debug hooks globally for this state. No hook callbacks will fire until hooks are re-enabled.
functions.deprecated: LJE automatically manages hooks now - does nothing.

functions.name: ignore_fn_once
functions.description: Causes the next hook event triggered by `fn` to be silently ignored. Only suppresses a single event — subsequent calls will fire normally.
functions.deprecated: LJE automatically manages hooks now - does nothing.

params.name: fn
params.description: The function whose next hook event should be ignored.
